info.name: List Counts of Individual Event Tasks

params.name: filter
params.description: Filters to be applied to the request.

items.docs:
Returns the total counts of actions taken in an event. The counted actions are: update, create, and delete.

Example:
```
event_task_counts?start=1592546400000&end=1593151199999
```

Authorization Action:
```
event:events:list
```

```
event_type_counts?start=1592546400000&end=1593151199999
```

Authorization Action:


params.name: page_size
params.description: Count of events to return per page.

params.name: after
params.description: Used for pagination, to request results in ascending order.

params.name: before
params.description: Used for pagination, to request results in descending order.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Used for pagination, to bookmark next set of results.

params.name: collapse
params.description: Used to group similar events together.

items.docs:
Returns a list of recorded events in Chef Automate, such as Infra Server events (cookbook creation, policyfile updates, and node creation) and Chef Automate internal events (profile installs and scan job creation).
Adding a filter makes a list of all events that meet the filter criteria.

Example:
```
eventfeed?collapse=true&filter=organization:4thcafe&page_size=100&start=1592546400000&end=1593151199999
```

Authorization Action:
```
event:events:list
```

params.name: timezone
params.description: User timezone to apply to request.

params.name: hours_between
params.description: Interval for returned results, for example: 1 hour buckets.

items.docs:
Returns data that populates the guitar strings visual on the top of the event feed.

Example:
```
eventstrings?timezone=America/Denver&hours_between=1&start=2020-06-19&end=2020-06-25
```

Authorization Action:
```
event:events:list
```
